name: Sentiment Analysis Tool
description: Analyzes text sentiment, emotion, and intent from customer feedback across channels

config.prompt:
Analyze the sentiment and emotion of this feedback. Return JSON with sentiment (positive/egative/neutral), emotion, and key themes:
{text}

config.code:
positive = sum(1 for r in results if r['sentiment'] == 'positive')
negative = sum(1 for r in results if r['sentiment'] == 'negative')
net_score = (positive - negative) / len(results)
return {'net_sentiment': net_score, 'positive_pct': positive/len(results)*100}
